preimages.payload_digest: JCS of the accepted contract object, excluding transport headers and server receipt metadata
preimages.manifest_sha256: JCS of the persisted manifest object; never include a field containing its own digest

assertions: profile_id owns device_id, event_id, job_id, and recommendation_version_id
request body IDs never override the owner resolved from the credential or grant
container input references the accepted upload manifest digest
container output references the input manifest digest
artifact manifest references the output manifest digest
container input and output carry the same job_type and input_digest
a digest mismatch rejects the transition without creating a new effect
candidate profile_id, recommendation_version_id, and revision equal the outer artifact manifest
candidate trust_domain equals the outer artifact trust_domain
candidate manifest_sha256 equals the RFC8785-JCS digest of the outer manifest
first revision has previous_revision null; later revisions have previous_revision equal to current revision
update occurs only when candidate_revision is greater than current_revision within the same profile and trust_domain
a stale candidate may remain immutable but must not replace latest_pointer
an IR client event must carry aggregate_eligible=false
aggregate_eligible is never trusted from an IR client
an aggregate-eligibility.v1 decision from official_worker is required
the decision requires official provenance, explicit non-revoked consent, SP7, and is_course=false
self_hosted records can never satisfy the decision
